name: Wedding motifs
desc: Shared decorative motifs: florals, Mughal architecture, lanterns and lights, crescent and stars, birds and keepsakes.

symbols.desc: Open rose seen from above: four rings of overlapping cupped petals with rolled rims around a spiral heart (--rose, default --bl).
Rosebud on a short stem with curling sepals and one leaf (--rose, --leaf).
Single leaf, two-tone with veins, stalk at bottom centre, tip up (--leaf, default --lv).
Curving stem with six leaves, base at bottom centre, tip at top (--leaf).
Motia (jasmine): five-petal ivory star flower with a soft gold-green centre (--jasmine, default --ef).
Genda (marigold): dense ruffled orange-gold pom-pom seen from the front (--marigold).
Mughal lotus, side view: symmetric fan of plump pointed petals with inlaid centres on a gold cup (--lotus, default --bl).
Motia lari: dense string of jasmine buds with two rose beads, hangs from the top centre (10,0) (--jasmine, --rose).
Genda string: marigold heads alternating orange and yellow with small roses and gold beads, ends in a tassel; hangs from the top centre (14,0) (--marigold, --marigold2, --rose).
Mosque silhouette: central onion dome with crescent finial, arched portal and two minarets (--sil, default --acc).
Lahore skyline silhouette: Badshahi-style mosque with three domes and four minarets, fort gate with bastions, Minar-e-Pakistan, trees (--sil, default --acc).
Jharokha: ornate balcony window with chhatri dome, chhajja eave, cusped open arch (see-through), jaali parapet and corbels; ivory body with gold line work (--jharokha, --metal).
Cusped Mughal arch frame: outer pointed arch, inner multifoil line with cusp dots and apex finial; hairline strokes stay thin at any size (--frame, default --acc).
Jaali lattice tile (8-point star and cross, double-line bars), tiles seamlessly edge to edge (--jaali, default --acc).
Mughal fanoos lantern with pierced arch windows over a warm glow, onion cap and tassel; hangs from the top centre (20,0) (--glow, --metal).
Round paper lantern, ribbed, glowing from inside, gold caps and tassel; hangs from the top centre (20,0) (--paper, default --bl).
Single warm fairy-light bulb with a soft glow halo and small socket; hangs from the top centre (12,0) (--glow).
Pillar candle in a hurricane glass on a gold foot, warm flame with halo (--glow, --candle default --ef, --metal).
Crystal chandelier: gold scroll arms with candles and flames, beaded swags and teardrop crystals; hangs from the top centre (50,0) (--glow, --metal, --crystal).
Crescent moon (hilal), horns to the upper right, with a bright rim (--moon, default --acc).
Faceted eight-point star (two interlaced squares) with light and dark facets and a jewel centre (--star, default --acc).
Four-point twinkle with a faint diagonal glint and bright core (--star, default --acc).
Crescent moon with a five-point star in its opening (Islamic hilal and star) (--moon, --star).
Kairi (paisley / boteh), tip curling to the upper right: jewel body with inlaid field, gold dotted border, central rosette and curl (--paisley, default --bl).
Peacock feather: fine barbs around a shaft, eye with gold ring, green band and dark heart; quill at the bottom centre (--feather, default --lv; --metal).
White dove in flight, wings raised, facing right (flip with scaleX(-1) to face left) (--dove, default --ef).
White dove gliding with wings spread wide, facing right (flip with scaleX(-1) to face left) (--dove, default --ef).
Truck-art ringneck parrot perched on a twig, facing right: green body, red hooked beak, neck ring, scalloped wing, long tail (--parrot, default --lv; --bl beak).
Elegant heart with an inner gold line and a soft highlight (--heart, default --bl).
Two interlocked gold wedding rings, the right one with a solitaire diamond (--metal, --gem).
Ribbon bow: two loops with inner folds, knot and two tails with V-cut ends (--ribbon, default --bl).
Gold tassel with cord loop, rounded head, collar and fringe; hangs from the top centre (12,0) (--tassel, default --acc).
Ghungroo: small round brass bell with a ridge, bottom slit and loop; hangs from the top centre (12,0) (--bell, default --acc).
